description:
Refactor src/prompt/dispatch.rs::run_exchange from one-shot (v0.2) to a step loop (v0.3).

=== Behavior ===

- Step seq becomes meaningful: 001, 002, … driven by the loop, not a constant FIRST_STEP_SEQ=1.
- Per step: snapshot commit (§2.10, current) → model call → response commit (current) → if response contains tool_use blocks, tool executor (stubbed here, real in #4) runs each; tool_call records commit per the ball-#1 contract → loop back to a new snapshot commit with tool_result blocks in the next user message.
- Loop terminates when the response's stop_reason is anything other than 'tool_use' — returning to the parent lands the exchange at the compactor + merge-back (existing behavior, unchanged).
- Tool execution goes through a new &dyn ToolExecutor in prompt::Deps. Ball #3 ships the trait + a test stub only; the real impl lands in #4. All new loop logic is testable end-to-end against the stub.

=== Depends on ===

bl-8be5 — loop reads tool_use from StepResponse and writes tool_result into the next request; both require the wire-type extension.

=== Out of scope ===

- Real tool execution (#4).
- bash / read_file tools (#5 / #6).
- Per-step tools:[…] assembly from config — stubbed to a fixed list for ball #3's tests; real assembly rides on #4 or a later ball.
title: v0.3 multi-step exchange loop
